title: Ferretti Yachts 860

specs.Extras: Tender launching system, hardtop, CCTV, wine cooler

highlights: Aft garage for jet tender and jet ski
Palatial flybridge with dining for ten
description:
A rare opportunity to acquire a nearly new Ferretti Yachts 860, available now in Thailand. This "mini-superyacht" delivers volume and features usually found on much larger yachts, with four spacious en-suite guest cabins.

Her aft garage takes both a jet tender and a jet ski, and the expansive flybridge offers dining for ten and a large aft lounge. Fitted with twin MAN 2,000 HP engines, a Seakeeper gyro, tender launching system, upgraded generator and 180 L/h watermaker.
